Recommendation: yes, keep all of it on-device and block AI and telemetry egress. Reason: repository evidence shows derived text goes to a remote AI provider today and telemetry can include payload excerpts. Impact: strongest privacy boundary, but any cloud-dependent analysis and excerpt-carrying telemetry must be disabled or replaced for this slice. Evidence: an on-device parser supports the primary format. Uncertainty: non-primary formats may not be feasible locally yet. Reversible: yes, this can ship first for the primary format only.","scripted_answer_index":0,"draft_ready":true}],"contract":{"G":"DECISION: Add local-only processing for the primary format, keeping file bytes, metadata, and derived text on this device, including AI and telemetry.","T":"FACT: A remote AI provider receives derived text today. FACT: Telemetry can include error payload excerpts. FACT: An on-device parser supports the primary format. DECISION: Replace remote content processing for the primary format with on-device processing. DECISION: Prevent telemetry from sending file bytes, metadata, or derived text.","S":"In scope: primary-format local parsing, local-only derived-text handling, blocking AI and telemetry content egress, and checks proving no file content leaves the device. ASSUMPTION: formats without evidenced on-device parsing remain outside this reversible slice.","V":"Verify primary-format processing succeeds without network egress of file bytes, metadata, or derived text. Verify telemetry redacts or drops content-bearing excerpts. Verify the remote AI path is not used for this slice.","X":"Stop if the requested local-only boundary cannot be met for the primary format without sending content off-device, or if required AI or telemetry egress cannot be disabled in-slice.","P":"Persist the explicit local-only boundary as product behavior for the primary format. Recommendation: allow support to refund up to a capped amount with a required reason, and require owner approval above that cap. Reason: support is currently read-only and no approval threshold or audit event exists. Impact: unblocks common cases while containing financial risk. Evidence: the provider already supports refunds, so the missing pieces are policy and controls. Uncertainty: the exact self-serve limit. Reversible: yes, the limit can be adjusted later.","scripted_answer_index":0,"draft_ready":false},{"question":"Outcome question: Within that authority, should support be limited to full refunds or allowed to issue partial refunds too? Recommendation: allow both full and partial refunds under the same limit and approval rule. Reason: the provider supports both and partial refunds reduce over-refunding. Impact: broader support action surface with the same control model. Evidence: repository evidence confirms full and partial refund APIs. Uncertainty: none beyond this policy choice. FACT: The support role currently has read-only billing access. FACT: No approval threshold or audit event exists. DECISION: Grant bounded refund authority to support. DECISION: Require owner approval above $100. DECISION: Create an audit event for every refund attempt and outcome.","S":"In scope: support refund action, full and partial refunds within the $100 limit, required reason capture, owner approval for larger refunds, role enforcement, audit logging, and verification of control paths.
